newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil traders have not heard of China soy deals.
newsitem.headline: Brazil traders have not heard of China soy deals.

text.p: Brazilian soybean traders said today they had not heard of any sizeable sales to China in recent days.
"Brazil is shipping something to China all the time but I've not heard of any large-scale deal in the last few days," one trader said.
There were rumors in the Chicago futures market today that China had overnight bought 45,000 to 50,000 tonnes of South American soybeans.
Brazilian traders did cite talk here however that two companies may have recently sold up to 95,000 tonnes of Brazilian soybeans to the U.S.
"We have seen no freight fixtures however. The problem is that you can be only sure that a ship is going to the U.S when it arrives in the U.S. Gulf," one dealer said.
